title: YTwsy/OpenSurge-for-Mac
claim: YTwsy/OpenSurge-for-Mac — Surge-style whole-home gateway and control plane for macOS — mihomo TUN, dnsmasq-powered DHCP/DNS, per-device routing, a
why_good: A Surge-style whole-home network gateway + control plane for macOS (mihomo TUN, DHCP/DNS) — turns a Mac into a prosumer router/firewall.
value: Prosumer one-time/pro license for power users and homelabbers, the way Surge itself monetizes.
risk: Niche prosumer networking; Surge/Clash ecosystems exist, and this leans on grey-area proxy tooling.
pick_reason: The project offers a specific product for macOS users that addresses advanced network management needs, which can be monetized.

zh.claim: YTwsy/OpenSurge-for-Mac —— macOS 上 Surge 风格的全屋网关与控制面板:mihomo TUN、dnsmasq 驱动的 DHCP/DNS。
zh.why_good: 给 macOS 的 Surge 风格全屋网络网关 + 控制面板——把 Mac 变成发烧友级路由/防火墙。
zh.value: 给发烧友和 homelab 用户卖一次性/专业授权,像 Surge 那样变现。
zh.risk: 发烧友网络细分;Surge/Clash 生态已在,而且它依赖灰色地带的代理工具。
